questions.stemHtml: A 45-year-old man presents with skin changes, reporting that his fingers have become thick and tight. He has developed painful ulcers on his fingertips that heal slowly. The physician notes shiny, taut skin on his face and limited neck extension. The given image shows the patient's facial features. Which of the following findings is NOT typically associated with the skin changes observed in this patient? {{caption_text}}

options.label: C
options.text: Fixed flexion contractures of the fingers

options.label: D
options.text: Telangiectasia on the face and hands
